title: Hymen
summary: The hymen is a thin, flexible fringe of tissue around the vaginal opening. It varies a lot between people and is not a reliable 'virginity' marker.
key_points: Many hymens stretch rather than 'break', and many people don't bleed the first time they have penetrative sex.
It can also wear thin from sports, tampons or everyday activity.
No exam can prove whether someone has had sex.
answer_guidance: Correct the virginity myth clearly but kindly; this myth causes real harm and shame.
